standfirst: Seed brief · 17 stories across 8 sectors · replaced on the first scheduled run

stories.title: NSE's ₹22,562-crore IPO closes 5.7x subscribed, priced above Nasdaq's multiple
stories.dek: India's largest-ever offer drew 5.69–5.71x demand across the book, with all portions covered. Investors accepted a valuation multiple richer than Nasdaq's, on the strength of NSE's derivatives volumes.
stories.why: The exchange that lists everyone is finally listing itself. Expect questions on why a monopoly-ish market infrastructure business earns a premium multiple — and on what SEBI's F&O curbs do to that earnings base.

stories.title: Nifty IT is the day's worst sector as HCLTech, Tech Mahindra and Infosys lead losses
stories.dek: IT was the heaviest drag on an otherwise mixed session; realty was the best performer. The sector has been 2026's weakest in India, on a US client spending freeze and AI-driven pricing deflation in services deals.
stories.why: The bear case is structural, not cyclical: if AI compresses per-seat pricing, the linear headcount-revenue model breaks. Have a view on whether Indian IT gets deflated or gets the deployment work.

stories.title: Fed delivers its first rate hike in three years; markets price 54% odds of another in October
stories.dek: The 10-year Treasury yield pushed through 5.0% and crude held above $100 a barrel on Middle East tensions. The Dow posted its worst week since March, down 1.7%.
stories.why: Higher US rates plus $100 oil is the worst combination for India — it pressures the rupee, FII flows and the import bill at the same time. This is the macro frame behind almost every India question right now.

stories.title: India's crude import bill jumps 48.4% to $74.8 billion in April–August
stories.dek: The year-on-year surge reflects both higher Brent and steady volume growth over the first five months of FY27.
stories.why: Straight line to the current account deficit and the rupee. A rough rule of thumb: every $10/bbl move costs India roughly 0.4% of GDP on the oil bill.

stories.title: US industrial production flat in August, missing the 0.3% consensus
stories.dek: Manufacturing output contracted 0.3% and capacity utilisation held at 76.3%.
stories.why: Softening output alongside a hiking Fed is the stagflation tell markets are watching. It also feeds the demand outlook for Indian exporters.

stories.title: Defence counters rally up to 10%; Unimech Aerospace and Apollo Micro lead
stories.dek: The move came against a flat-to-weak broader tape, with capital goods and realty also holding up.
stories.why: Order-book visibility is doing the work here, not earnings. Useful as a live example of how policy-driven capex cycles get priced ahead of delivery.

stories.title: Sterling & Wilson jumps 7.7% on ₹985 crore of new orders; JSW Infrastructure up 7.4%
stories.dek: JSW Infrastructure touched ₹375.50, now up 57% so far in FY27.
stories.why: Two clean reads on the infrastructure and renewables order cycle — the kind of specific example that beats a generic 'capex is strong' answer.

stories.title: ChrysCapital to steer 20–25% of its new $2.2 billion fund into pharma and healthcare
stories.dek: The PE firm is backing CDMO, hospitals and diagnostics as its highest-conviction India theme.
stories.why: Domestic PE dry powder rotating into healthcare is a useful data point on where India's private capital sees durable margins — a good answer to 'which sector would you invest in'.

stories.title: Indian pharma warns of price hikes as energy costs surge
stories.dek: Manufacturers flag rising power and fuel costs feeding into API and formulation economics, with pricing largely capped under NPPA rules.
stories.why: A margin-squeeze story where the output price is regulated and the input price isn't — textbook setup for a cost pass-through discussion.

stories.title: Brokerages lift bank targets as credit growth improves; ICRA still sees FY27 moderating to 11.0–11.7%
stories.dek: ICICI Bank, SBI, HDFC Bank, DCB and South Indian Bank saw target revisions. Separately, HDFC Bank's Nifty weight lead over ICICI has narrowed to a 16-year low.
stories.why: Two opposing signals: sell-side optimism on near-term credit against a rating agency's moderating full-year forecast. Knowing both is what separates a real answer from a headline.

stories.title: Spinny confidentially pre-files for IPO; Definedge raises ₹22 crore
stories.dek: The used-car platform joins a crowded 2026 listing pipeline. Earlier this month Flam raised $40 million and SEBI cleared Fibe's ₹750 crore IPO.
stories.why: Confidential pre-filing lets a company test the market without publishing numbers — worth knowing as a mechanism, not just a headline.

stories.title: AceVector, Snapdeal's parent, opens its IPO on 25 September at a $182 million valuation
stories.dek: A steep markdown from the company's private-market peak.
stories.why: The clearest live example of the 2021 cohort resetting to public-market reality. Handy when asked about down-round IPOs or venture-stage valuation discipline.

stories.title: President Murmu presents the 72nd National Film Awards at Kevadia; 'Article 370' wins Best Feature Film
stories.dek: The ceremony moved to Ekta Nagar in Gujarat this year.

stories.title: Jaishankar leads India's delegation through UNGA high-level week in New York
stories.dek: Trade, reform of multilateral institutions and regional security are on India's agenda.

stories.title: Piyush Goyal chairs a DPIIT session on free trade agreements and ease of doing business
stories.dek: Runs alongside the ninth India International Water Week in New Delhi, on climate-resilient water management, through 26 September.
stories.why: FTA progress is the lever India is pulling against a higher-tariff global trade backdrop — worth tracking week to week.

stories.title: IMD issues heavy rainfall warnings for Telangana, Chhattisgarh and Kerala
stories.dek: Significant rain expected over the coming days as the monsoon withdraws unevenly.

stories.title: India play Japan in a first-ever men's T20I at Sano; women's side reaches the Asian Games final
stories.dek: Japan's first T20I against a full ICC member. India's women beat Bangladesh to make the final.
